budget_ruling.the_decisive_observation: THE TWO PRODUCERS MEASURED 'BUDGET' AGAINST DIFFERENT CLOCKS, AND EACH WAS SELF-CONSISTENT UNDER ITS OWN READING. TASK-806 measured COMPUTE (67 s of 1600, no overrun, and it says so). TASK-807 measured SESSION ELAPSED (~1510 of 1200, overrun, and it says so). Neither producer misread its card, because the card does not say. That is not two producers erring in the same place; it is ONE INSTRUMENT WITH NO UNITS.

ruling.primary: AMENDMENT-003 DRAFTING FAULT, COORDINATOR-SIDE. protocol-amendment-GOAL-AES-001-003 fixes the ACCOUNTING basis against the campaign ceiling as 'MEASURED wall-clock time of COMPLETED tasks' — a quantity the DISPATCHING SESSION observes — and separately states that 'a task that reaches its declared handoff.budget.wall_clock_seconds STILL HALTS'. IT NEVER SAYS WHICH CLOCK THE PRODUCER MUST STOP AGAINST. The amendment charges a dispatcher-observed quantity while imposing the stop duty on the producer, and the producer cannot observe that quantity: there is no instrumented timer in this repository (amendment 003's own `limitations` says so), and TASK-807's ~1434 s figure is itself an estimate rather than a measurement. A stop condition a producer cannot evaluate is not a stop condition, and drafting it that way is the Coordinator's fault and not the producers'.
ruling.secondary: RECORDING DEFECT, CAMPAIGN-SIDE. No timing artifact is committed anywhere in this repository, so neither overrun is re-derivable from the tree by a later session. Both figures are dispatcher observations relayed into this receipt. Amendment 003 disclosed this as a standing cost of the measured basis; BATCH-004 is the first batch where it BINDS, because it is the first batch in which a per-task stop condition was actually crossed.
ruling.not_a_producer_defect: NEITHER PRODUCER IS CHARGED WITH A DEFECT AND NEITHER IS RETURNED. TASK-806 halted on completion under the only clock it measured. TASK-807 disclosed its overrun unprompted, in a machine-readable deviations list, with the dropped work named. PENALISING DEV-807-4 WOULD BE ACTIVELY HARMFUL: it would teach every future producer that the cheapest response to an overrun is not to report one, and this campaign's whole evidentiary posture depends on producers reporting inconvenient facts about themselves. DEV-807-4 is recorded as CORRECT CONDUCT under an unclear rule.
ruling.not_a_negative_result_and_not_a_repair_i: AGENTS.md rule 5 governs the consequence: a budget halt is INFRASTRUCTURE SIGNAL, never a negative mathematical result. TASK-20260801-807's three dropped items are therefore NOT evidence that the exhaustive closure, the surviving-partition certificates or the larger-set witness would have failed. They are UNMEASURED, and they are recorded here as SCOPE, so that no later decision can read the gap as an answer. NO REPAIR TASK IS OPENED AGAINST EITHER PRODUCER; there is nothing in either package to repair.

what_BATCH_005_must_do_about_it: 1. AUTHOR protocol-amendment-GOAL-AES-001-005 NAMING THE BINDING CLOCK, before dispatching any producer task. It must state (a) which clock the per-task stop condition is evaluated against, (b) which clock is charged against the 20000 s ceiling, and (c) what a producer must do when it cannot observe the charged clock. The Coordinator's recommendation, to be ruled on in TASK-20260801-811 or at BATCH-005 opening and NOT decided here: charge SESSION ELAPSED (unchanged, since that is what the campaign actually consumes) and give the producer an AUDITABLE PROXY DUTY in place of an unobservable stop — record a UTC stamp as the first act in its directory and a UTC stamp at each major section boundary, halt when start + declared is reached, and commit those stamps. That converts an unevaluable condition into one a producer can evaluate and a reviewer can read from committed bytes.

2. RE-CALIBRATE DECLARATIONS AGAINST AUTHORING-INCLUSIVE ELAPSED, NOT COMPUTE. Both BATCH-004 producer overruns were authoring, not compute: 67 s and ~254 s of compute against 1609 s and 1510 s elapsed. The campaign's `per_task_reference_actuals` are authoring-dominated numbers and BATCH-005 must declare against them as such, with the compute component stated separately so the two are never again conflated.

3. RESOLVE THE CEILING BEFORE PLANNING THE WORK. With ~180 s of worst-case headroom, BATCH-005's first act is a budget amendment or a declared pause — not a research queue. A queue drafted before that is drafted against a number that does not exist.

4. CARRY DEV-807-4's DROPPED WORK FORWARD AS SCOPE, NOT AS RESULT. The exhaustive closure over all 2^16 patterns, the surviving-partition certificates for restricted target cases, and the larger-set group (a) witness are UNMEASURED.
